title: Wiki
description: The wiki's spaces: who reads each one, and the drafts and schedules of its pages. Pages are written in the wiki itself.
newDescription: A space collects pages and decides who reads them. Its pages are written in the wiki.
emptyHint: Create the first space; its pages are written in the wiki.

name.label: Name
name.hint: The space's address is made from the name when the space is created and does not change.

visibility.label: Who reads it
visibility.hint: Editors and admins read every space.
visibility.confirmAudience: This would show the space to everyone. Tick “Confirm this audience when saving” to do that, or choose who reads it.

department.label: Department
department.visibilityTarget: Choose the department that reads the space.

team.label: Team
team.visibilityTarget: Choose the team that reads the space.

_form.spaceNotEmpty: This space still has pages, so it cannot be deleted. Move or delete its pages first.

list.pages: {count, plural, =0 {No pages} one {# page} other {# pages}}

space.description: Every page of this space, drafts and schedules included.
space.emptyHint: Write the first page in the wiki.
space.truncated: Not every page could be loaded; some may be missing from the tree.
space.deleteHasPages: This space has {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}. It can be deleted only when it is empty.
space.deleteBody: The space is removed for good. This cannot be undone.

editor.newDescription: In {space}. Save draft keeps the page unpublished; Publish shows it to everyone who reads the space.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: One or two sentences under the title and in the space's list of pages.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Separate them with commas, for example: onboarding, laptop. Up to 20.
tags.tooLong: A tag can have up to 100 characters.

tocEnabled.label: Show a table of contents
tocEnabled.hint: Lists the text's headings above it.

order.label: Order
order.hint: 0 to 10000; lower numbers come first in the space.

parent.label: Parent page
parent.hint: The page is listed below its parent. Published pages of this space can be parents.
parent.notPublishable: The parent page is not published. Publish it first, or choose another parent.

department.label: Department
department.hint: Its head may edit the page.

team.label: Team
team.hint: Its lead may edit the page.

revisionSummary.label: Change note
revisionSummary.hint: What you changed, for the page's history. Optional.

space.invalid: This space no longer exists, or you can no longer write in it.
space.required: This space no longer exists, or you can no longer write in it.

editor.parentsFailed: The pages of this space could not be loaded, so the parent cannot be changed right now. Reload the page to try again.
editor.parentsTruncated: Not every page of this space could be loaded; some may be missing from the list.
editor.deleteDraftBody: The page has never been published, so the draft is deleted for good.
editor.noSpace: The page's space no longer exists.

drafts.title: My drafts
drafts.description: Your wiki pages with changes that are not published yet.
drafts.emptyHint: Pages you save as a draft are listed here until they are published.

history.title: History
history.description: Every saved version of “{title}”, newest first. Restoring a version publishes it as a new version; nothing is lost.
history.emptyHint: Each save of the page adds a version here.
history.previewLegacy: This older entry holds only the text from before an edit. Restoring it gives the page this text and keeps its current title and summary.
history.previewNotFound: This version does not belong to the page, or it no longer exists.
history.previewFailed: This version could not be loaded.
history.restoreBody: The page gets this version's title, summary and text and is published at once. The history keeps every version.
history.restoreBodyLegacy: The page gets this version's text and keeps its current title and summary. It is published at once. The history keeps every version.
